moshier.reference: Swiss Ephemeris 2.10.03 / sweph 2.10.3-7, explicit built-in Moshier; apparent geocentric true ecliptic of date, UT input

horizons.reference: NASA/JPL Horizons quantity 31, geocentric IAU76/80 apparent ecliptic of date; airless; UT input (UT1 before 1962, UTC afterward); includes gravitational deflection unlike the adapter. Future UTC uses last known leap-second while adapter predicts delta-T.

limitations: Finite empirical comparisons do not prove a universal 0.05-degree physical error bound.
The analytic interval enclosure applies to the pinned engine model, not ephemeris truth.
Future stress epochs beyond asOf are not currently admitted birth dates.
Node wall timings are not hosted CPU measurements.
